digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud S3 rehearsal test suite
propositions: A read-only S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project test suite must be created to exercise the S3 store backend and real Cloud ticket volume/diversity across projects REB and DIG
The test suite must structurally enforce read-only behavior by monkeypatching all mutating AcliClient methods to raise, ensuring no writes to Jira or the store
The inbound fetch via compute_snapshot and bridge_preview in DRY_RUN mode must fetch both REB and DIG projects at real volume with correct per-project attribution
The test suite must use an isolated S3-backed store with a throwaway git remote prefix that is deleted on teardown, never touching production
Per-project Jira issue counts must remain identical before and after all test scenarios, and unknown project keys must fail closed with an exception
The suite must be integrated into CI as a dedicated workflow_dispatch job with separate collection from the general external test job
